properties.site-address: Scots Gap Auction Mart, Scots Gap
properties.notes: Operating auction mart that comprises extensive buildings, associated facilities and land. The site represents a sizeable area of brownfield land in a rural location. However, given the presence of an operational business, which performs an important role in the local community, the site is not available in the short-term. There is no indication that relocation is currently being looked at but potential for redevelopment may exist in the longer-term. This could be either in whole or part, depending on future commercial and business requirements. Any residential development would need to be reflective of the wider village and isolated location and an indicative yield of 30 dwellings is considered fitting.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
